payload.rebuttal: fixed: _parent_pairs assumed entry["versions"] was always a list of mappings; a JSON null there, or a non-mapping item in the list, raised TypeError or AttributeError uncaught, aborting every remaining parent in depends_on rather than marking just the one bad parent unreadable. Added explicit isinstance checks for the versions list and for each version item, raising the existing _Unreadable in both cases so a malformed versions value degrades the same way a missing versions key already does.
